text.en: A student said 9,990 is greater than 49,014 because 9 is bigger than 4. Is the student right? Let us find out how to compare numbers properly.

To compare two numbers, first count their digits. A number with more digits is greater, so 49,014 with five digits is greater than 9,990 with four digits. The student was not correct.
If both numbers have the same number of digits, compare the digits from the left, starting with the biggest place.
The place value chart helps. Write each number in the columns TTh, Th, H, T and O and compare column by column.
Take 40,347 and 40,473. Both have 4 in the ten thousands and 0 in the thousands. In the hundreds, 3 is smaller than 4, so 40,347 is smaller than 40,473.
A number line also helps. Numbers further to the right are greater. Mark 0, 20,000, 40,000, 60,000 and 80,000 and place the numbers between them.
To arrange numbers in increasing order, put the smallest first. For decreasing order, start with the greatest.
The book also plays digit swap. In 1,478 you can interchange two digits to make a bigger number, like 7,418 or 8,471, because a bigger digit in a higher place makes the number larger.

34,407 and 34,740 both have 34 thousands. Compare hundreds: 4 is less than 7, so 34,407 comes before 34,740.

why.en: When one place is equal, move to the next.
Check each neighbour pair once more.

prompt.en: How do you decide which of two big numbers is greater?

requiredIdeas.en: Count digits: more digits is greater
With equal digits compare from the left
Use a place value chart or number line

commonMisconceptions.en: Thinking the number with the bigger last digit is greater

points.en: More digits means a greater number.
With equal digits, compare from the left, place by place.
Number lines and place value charts help us order numbers.
